title: centropogon trianae var. purdieanus
intro: Centropogon trianae var. purdieanus, commonly known as "Blue Button Flower", is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to exert antimicrobial and antifungal activities, making it a possible treatment for infections. The bioactive constituents of Centropogon trianae var. purdieanus include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
